# Tools


## Built-in tools


  | Tool         | Risk   | Purpose                                                           |
  | ------       | ------ | ---------                                                         |
  | `read_file`  | low    | Read file contents (workspace-relative or `/workspace/`-prefixed) |
  | `edit_file`  | high   | Replace a file's contents                                         |
  | `write_file` | high   | Create or overwrite a file                                        |

The workspace root mounts at `/workspace/`; path normalization blocks escapes (`..`, `~`, absolute paths outside the root).
